Chapter 170 Gu Chen'S Luck In Love

At the same time, the Emperor's Capital of the Divine Dynasty.

With the sound of buzzing sounds.

Several powerful figures were coming towards the imperial capital in a huge momentum, with a huge momentum.

Above the city wall, the guards of the Divine Dynasty looked solemn.

However, when everyone saw the identity of the visitor clearly, they were immediately excited.

"It's the Sword God who is the one who is here, everyone is back!"

"Hurry, go and notify Lord Aoqing and Lord Zhou."

In less than a moment, two figures appeared outside the imperial capital.

It was Ao Qing and Mr. Zhou.

"Jian Xin, where is Your Majesty?"

Mr. Zhou looked at everyone and asked.

Hearing this, Jian Xin said, "Your Majesty asks me to come back first."

Hearing this, Mr. Zhou nodded and said nothing.

At this moment, Huangcheng Awei and others saw Ao Qing and were stunned.

"Well, Ao Qing, why are you the only one, Miss?"

In their perception, Ao Qing has always been inseparable from Lu Xue.

This time I saw only Ao Qing, and everyone suddenly felt a little unaccustomed.

"Haha, I don't need me to be with you."

Ao Qing had a hint of sadness in his eyes and sighed from the void.

It seems like he has just fallen out of favor.

Hearing this, everyone in Huangcheng was shocked.

The city lord is back!

No wonder.

As early as on their way back, they noticed terrifying fluctuations coming from the unknown border.

That aura was not the city lord's wife, nor the aura of the spirit-eating tribe.

It turned out to be the city lord.

In this case, the Spirit-Devouring Clan would probably have been wiped out in ashes at this moment.

Everyone looked at each other and nodded immediately.

"Go back to the deserted city."

"good."

Awei and others hit it off and were about to leave immediately.

At this time, Gu Chen was suddenly stunned and quickly poked Awei with his arm, looking at Jian Xin Muyu and others not far away.

Seeing this, Awei immediately understood.

"Miss Jianxin, Miss Mu Yu."

Gu Chen walked towards the two of them with a smile on his face.

When they saw Gu Chen, the two nodded.

"Brother Gu, is there anything wrong?"

Jian Xin spoke.

Upon hearing this, Gu Chen smiled and said, "Do you two know about my Lord of the Wilderness City?"

The Lord of the Huangcheng City, Lu Daosheng.

Of course, the two of them knew this name.

Although I am not in the imperial capital for many years, I am still very clear about the matters in the imperial capital.

It is rumored that the Lord of the Huangcheng City has a close relationship with their Majesty.

This is also the reason why the two forces are so close.

At this time, Gu Chen continued, "Two girls, in fact, your Majesty is the wife of my city lord, and our city lord's wife."

As soon as these words were spoken, Jian Xin and others were shocked.

But it's just a little bit.

A long time ago, when Yan Lingyun brought Lu Xue back to the Divine Dynasty, they had already guessed something.

"What do you want to say?"

Jian Xin asked.

Looking at Jian Xin and Mu Yu, Gu Chen smiled and said, "It's nothing, but now I think my city lord has taken his wife and lady back to the Huangcheng."

"So I want to invite you to the deserted city too."

Go to the deserted city.

Jian Xin did not speak, but turned his head to look at Mu Yu who had been silent on the side.

At this time, Mu Yu was actually looking at Gu Chen with his eyes trance.

Seeing this, Jian Xindai frowned slightly and quickly woke up the other party.

"Mu Yu."

Hearing someone calling him, Mu Yu hurriedly came back to his senses, "Ah, go to the deserted city, go, go."

Looking at Mu Yu's somewhat panicked look, Jian Xin sighed lightly, then glanced at Gu Chen with a strange look.

But Gu Chen did not notice the reactions of everyone around him.

I was also immersed in the joy of success in my plan.

As long as the gods are turned to the desolate city, their desolate city will inevitably grow stronger by then.

Hahaha, I am a genius.

"Viagra, do you see anything?"

At this time, An Xing suddenly appeared beside Awei at some point and said with a mysterious smile.

Awei nodded slightly.

"These two have stories."

"Why would you like to remind Brother Gu? I think he is a little unwitting."

Upon hearing this, Awei hesitated and said, "It shouldn't be necessary. After all, how could a big man not understand this?"

Immediately, Awei took everyone in Huangcheng to return to Huangcheng.

Jian Xin Muyu and the other gods also followed everyone.

Standing in front of the towering city of the imperial capital of the Divine Dynasty, Old Zhou watched everyone leave.

For some reason, he always had an ominous premonition.

In the void.

"That, thank you for saving me."

Mu Yu came to Gu Chen with a uniquely shaped staff and whispered.

Hearing this, Gu Chen smiled and said, "You're welcome, they are all their own people, they should."

The two were very close, and Gu Chen suddenly discovered that this divine general named Mu Yu had a faint fragrance on his body, which made him feel relaxed and happy.

"Ahem, what, what, what do the girl thinks of me in the deserted city?"

Gu Chen didn't dare to think too much and quickly continued his plan.

"Wild City, well, I heard them talk about it. They all said that Wild City is good, but I haven't been there."

Mu Yu tightened the staff in his hand and said slowly.

Upon hearing this, Gu Chen laughed.

"Don't worry, Miss Mu, when you arrive at Huangcheng, you will definitely fall in love with our Huangcheng."

Seeing Gu Chen in a good mood, Mu Yu also smiled and nodded immediately.

"good."

And not far away.

Three figures were watching this scene with different expressions.

"Viagra, what do you think?"

An Xing's complexion.

Upon hearing this, Awei sighed, "I won't comment."

Jian Xin said indifferently: "This is the first time I have seen Mu Yu approach a man so proactively."

The three of them saw it very thoroughly and knew what it meant.

But it seems that Gu Chen didn't realize anything.

Awei and An Xing looked at each other and nodded.

It seems that I have to go back and mention that guy.

.........

The deserted city.

Lu Daosheng came outside the wasteland city, looked at his hard work, and then smiled.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng stretched his arms and his breath leaked wildly without any concealment.

Suddenly, the entire deserted city began to tremble.

This aura is very strong, but it has no effect on the people in Huangcheng, but it is a bit comfortable.

"Your city lord is back!"

Lu Daosheng laughed.

Suddenly, the voice sounded from the entire deserted city. .

Then Lu Daosheng took a step forward and came directly above the deserted city.

When they saw Lu Daosheng, the residents of the deserted city immediately cheered.

Countless people stood on the street, dancing.

"City Lord! City Lord!!"

"Sir, the city lord, look at me, I want to give birth to a monkey with you!!"

"But you are a fucking man!!!"

Looking at the cheers of everyone below, Lu Daosheng smiled even deeper.

Everything I did felt more meaningful.

Among them, the one with the strongest aura is the people from the three major families in Huangcheng.

Lu Daosheng came to the inner city.

The heads of the three major families immediately greeted each other with a smile.

"I've seen the city lord!"

Lu Daosheng nodded.

At this time, three somewhat old but extremely energetic old guys came over from the crowd.

"Everyone is allowed to let go, I don't know how to care for the elderly!"
